description.en: Sum of the four standalone quarters ending September 30, 2026, in the final IPO prospectus.
description.zh: 采用最终上市招股书中截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的最近四个单季营收之和。

description.en: 13.220 billion legally outstanding common shares across classes after the IPO and concurrent private placement, before over-allotment and additional unissued awards.
description.zh: 按 IPO 和同期私募完成后的全部普通股类别计算，共约 132.20 亿股。股数采用法律流通口径，未计入超额配售或尚未发行的股权奖励。

description.en: September 30 capitalization adjusted for the offering and private placement. Cash includes short-term investments. Debt uses the remaining convertible notes at carrying value, with no assumed future conversion.
description.zh: 以 9 月 30 日资本结构为基础，按 IPO 与同期私募调整。现金包括短期投资；债务采用剩余可转债账面值，未假定未来转股。

label.en: Final IPO prospectus · quarterly results, offering and capitalization
label.zh: 最终上市招股书：分季业绩、发行与资本结构

method_note.en: Revenue growth and EV / revenue are research assumptions reflecting expected economics and risk. The equity bridge uses disclosed carrying values. The multiple is sensitive to future margins and funding requirements.
method_note.zh: 营收增速和企业价值／营收倍数是反映业务预期与风险的研究假设。由企业价值换算至股权价值时采用披露账面值。倍数对未来利润率与资金需求敏感。

rationale.en: Compute commitments rise faster than monetization and usage growth slows.
rationale.zh: 算力承诺增长快于变现，使用量增速放缓。

rationale.en: API and enterprise demand scale while inference costs remain a major constraint.
rationale.zh: API 和企业需求扩大，推理成本仍是主要制约。

rationale.en: Enterprise adoption broadens and utilization improves the economics of new capacity.
rationale.zh: 企业采用面扩大，利用率改善新增算力的经济性。
